sentences.show: Imagine verifying identity with just the phone in your hand.
sentences.say: Imagine verifying identity with just the phone in your hand.

sentences.show: No scanner. No touch. Just a camera.
sentences.say: No scanner, no touch, just a camera.

sentences.show: Today, fingerprint authentication needs dedicated scanners to buy, deploy and maintain.
sentences.say: Today, fingerprint authentication needs dedicated scanners to buy, deploy and maintain.

sentences.show: YellowSense turns the camera of a smartphone into a contactless fingerprint reader.
sentences.say: Yellow Sense turns the camera of a smartphone into a contactless fingerprint reader.

sentences.show: One app handles both enrollment and authentication.
sentences.say: One app handles both enrollment and authentication.

sentences.show: Let's start with enrollment.
sentences.say: Let's start with enrollment.

sentences.show: The operator enters the person's name and ID number.
sentences.say: The operator enters the person's name and ID number.

sentences.show: Then selects the region.
sentences.say: Then selects the region.

sentences.show: The person holds one index finger in front of the rear camera.
sentences.say: The person holds one index finger in front of the rear camera.

sentences.show: Auto-capture takes the shot once the finger is steady and in focus.
sentences.say: Auto-capture takes the shot once the finger is steady and in focus.

sentences.show: The app checks image quality, finds the finger, and runs a liveness check.
sentences.say: The app checks image quality, finds the finger, and runs a liveness check.

sentences.show: Including the capture, enrollment takes about ten seconds.
sentences.say: Including the capture, enrollment takes about ten seconds.

sentences.show: The result card reports the capture as live.
sentences.say: The result card reports the capture as live.

sentences.show: To authenticate, the operator opens the Authenticate screen.
sentences.say: To authenticate, the operator opens the Authenticate screen.

sentences.show: The match runs against the users enrolled in the chosen region.
sentences.say: The match runs against the users enrolled in the chosen region.

sentences.show: The person scans the same finger again.
sentences.say: The person scans the same finger again.

sentences.show: The same processing steps run first.
sentences.say: The same processing steps run first.

sentences.show: The match itself takes under a second, and the person is authenticated.
sentences.say: The match itself takes under a second, and the person is authenticated.

sentences.show: Under the hood, five stages do the heavy lifting.
sentences.say: Under the hood, five stages do the heavy lifting.

sentences.show: YOLO finds the finger.
sentences.say: YOLO finds the finger.

sentences.show: A liveness check classifies each capture as live or not.
sentences.say: A liveness check classifies each capture as live or not.

sentences.show: U²-Net segments it.
sentences.say: U squared Net segments it.

sentences.show: Enhancement brings out the ridges, with Zero-DCE for low light.
sentences.say: Enhancement brings out the ridges, with Zero D C E for low light.

sentences.show: And in the cloud, the print becomes a template and is matched.
sentences.say: And in the cloud, the print becomes a template and is matched.

sentences.show: Slap mode captures four fingers in a single shot.
sentences.say: Slap mode captures four fingers in a single shot.

sentences.show: The home screen also offers one-to-one verification, a pipeline view, and a quality check tool.
sentences.say: The home screen also offers one-to-one verification, a pipeline view, and a quality check tool.

sentences.show: The operator fills in the same details, and chooses which hand to scan.
sentences.say: The operator fills in the same details, and chooses which hand to scan.

sentences.show: Here, it is the left hand.
sentences.say: Here, it is the left hand.

sentences.show: The person holds four fingers sideways in front of the rear camera.
sentences.say: The person holds four fingers sideways in front of the rear camera.

sentences.show: Detection boxes lock onto each fingertip, and the app checks liveness.
sentences.say: Detection boxes lock onto each fingertip, and the app checks liveness.

sentences.show: Every finger is detected, checked for liveness, and processed on its own.
sentences.say: Every finger is detected, checked for liveness, and processed on its own.

sentences.show: All four fingers are enrolled.
sentences.say: All four fingers are enrolled.

sentences.show: To authenticate, the person scans the same hand again.
sentences.say: To authenticate, the person scans the same hand again.

sentences.show: The same checks run on every finger.
sentences.say: The same checks run on every finger.

sentences.show: Authentication needs at least two matching fingers.
sentences.say: Authentication needs at least two matching fingers.

sentences.show: Here, all four passed, and the match took under a second.
sentences.say: Here, all four passed, and the match took under a second.

sentences.show: The slap pipeline view lets you watch a capture step by step.
sentences.say: The slap pipeline view lets you watch a capture step by step.

sentences.show: While it processes, each finger is cropped and checked on its own.
sentences.say: While it processes, each finger is cropped and checked on its own.

sentences.show: Then every fingertip appears with its crop, its liveness result, and a processed ridge image.
sentences.say: Then every fingertip appears with its crop, its liveness result, and a processed ridge image.

sentences.show: Our target is over 85% matching accuracy.
sentences.say: Our target is over eighty-five percent matching accuracy.

sentences.show: That is the acceptance target for this proof of concept.
